name: Turla - Snake Emulation Plan
desc: The emulation plan, created by the ATT&CK ® Evaluations team, used during Day 2 of the ATT&CK evaluations Round 5. This scenario focuses on Snake, a rootkit used to compromise computers and exfiltrate data.

acts.d: Egle browses to a legitimate, but compromised, website and is redirected to a malicious version of the website hosted by the attacker
Multiple snippets of JavaScript are executed in the browser
The malicious WordPress website prompts the user to update their NotFlash. The user clicks to download the update containing EPIC
An additional executable is embedded inside NFVersion_5e.exe via the Resource section
NFVersion_5e.exe writes the EPIC Injector to the user's path (indicated by the %TEMP% environment variable) as mxs_installer.exe
NFVersion_5e.exe modifies a registry key
EPIC's guard DLL is embedded inside the resource section of mxs_installer.exe
mxs_installer.exe injects EPIC's Guard DLL into explorer.exe
explorer.exe enumerates processes looking for internet-enabled processes
the EPIC worker DLL (the EPIC payload) is embedded in the resource section of the explorer.exe's Guard DLL
EPIC's worker DLL is injected into msedge.exe
msedge.exe connects to the adversary's compromised proxy over HTTPS protocol
cmd.exe executes discovery commands to learn information about the host computer
cmd.exe executes discovery commands to learn information about the domain computers
msedge.exe downloads gusbsys.exe to the user's desktop
the Snake Installer (gusbsys.exe) drops a vulnerable driver into the Snake directory and then installs it
the Snake Installer (gusbsys.exe) disables driver signature enforcement (DSE) by loading and exploiting the vulnerable driver
the Snake Installer (gusbsys.exe) drops the Snake rootkit into the Snake directory and then installs it
the Snake Installer (gusbsys.exe) removes the vulnerable driver (gigabit.sys) and re-enables DSE
the Snake rootkit (gusb.sys) XOR decodes msnsvcx64.dll
msnsvcx64.dll is embedded inside the Snake rootkit (gusb.sys)
the Snake rootkit (gusb.sys) hooks various SYSCALL functions at runtime
the Snake rootkit (gusb.sys) registers a Filtering Windows Platform Management (FWPM) Filter
the Snake rootkit (gusb.sys) injects msnsvcx64.dll into taskhostw.exe for SYSTEM privileges. This is used to execute tasks received from the C2
msedge.exe XOR encrypts HTTP traffic to bestcafeswimxp2.com
the Snake rootkit (gusb.sys) injects msnsvcx64.dll into msedge.exe for communications with the C2 over HTTP
taskhostw.exe receives a command from the C2 and executes the command via CreateProcessW. taskhostw.exe enumerates currently running processes on the local computer
taskhostw.exe writes the command output to a named pipe - commsecdev - that msedge.exe reads
taskhostw.exe enumerates the EgleAdmin user
taskhostw.exe enumerates a list of running processes on the local machine via CreateToolhelp32Snapshot
taskhostw.exe duplicates Egle's access token
taskhostw.exe uses CreateProcessWithTokenW to execute net.exe with Egle's access token
taskhostw.exe enumerates a list of shares on the local machine
msedge.exe downloads PsExec and a 2nd Snake Installer to the system32 folder
the files are downloaded to a named pipe - commctrldev - that taskhostw.exe reads
taskhostw.exe authenticates as EgleAdmin to gain access to BERZAS
PsExec (file_svc_mgr.exe) executes the Snake Installer (cmu_svc_v2.exe) on BERZAS as EgleAdmin
msedge.exe connects to cheapinfomedical99.net over HTTP protocol
taskhostw.exe deletes file_svc_mgr.exe and cmu_svc_v2.exe on AZUOLAS
taskhostw.exe executes powershell.exe to check if the ActiveDirectory PowerShell module is installed
taskhostw.exe enumerates Active Directory groups containing the word "management" via Get-ADGroup
taskhostw.exe enumerates the usernames of accounts within the Server Management and Domain Admins domain groups via Get-ADGroupMember
taskhostw.exe enumerates account information via Get-ADUser
taskhostw.exe enumerates domain computers and their relevant information (IP addresses, DNS names, and description) via Get-ADComputer
msedge.exe downloads Mimikatz, PsExec, and a Snake installer to the system32 folder on BERZAS
the files are downloaded to a named pipe - commctrldev - that taskhostw.exe reads
taskhostw.exe dumps credentials using Mimikatz
taskhostw.exe executes a pass-the-hash attack to authenticate as ZilvinasAdmin on BERZAS
taskhostw.exe executes PsExec (fs_mgr.exe) to execute the Snake Installer (cmu_svc.exe) on UOSIS
msedge.exe connects to gamesiteworldwide2023.org over HTTP protocol
taskhostw.exe deletes Mimikatz (loadperf.exe), PsExec (fs_mgr.exe), and the Snake Installer (cmu_svc.exe) from BERZAS
taskhostw.exe enumerates running processes on UOSIS

taskhostw.exe creates a new domain admin user using the ZilvinasAdmin access token. Leshy is added to the Domain Admins group. The new user is a backdoor domain admin account for persistence on the domain. However, this scenario does not use Leshy.
taskhostw.exe downloads and writes LightNeuron files to the system32 folder on UOSIS
the files are downloaded to a named pipe - commctrldev - that taskhostw.exe reads
LightNeuron files copied to DREBULE C$ are renamed
taskhostw.exe uses token impersonation as ZilvinasAdmin to copy files to DREBULE C$
winmail.dat masquerades as the file attachment created by Microsoft Outlook when messages are sent from an incorrectly configured mail client
taskhostw.exe uses WMIC and PowerShell to execute the LightNeuron Transport Installation script (msiex.ps1) on DREBULE, via CreateProcessWithToken, using a copy of the ZilvinasAdmin token on UOSIS
cmd.exe executes powershell.exe on DREBULE
the LightNeuron Transport Agent is installed on the Exchange Server, masquerading as a benign connection filtering agent - Microsoft.Exchange.Transport.Agent.ConnectionFiltering.dll
taskhostw.exe deletes msiex.ps1, wdr.rules.xml, mtxconf.dll, mtxcli.dll, perfe009.dat on UOSIS
EdgeTransport.exe collects and logs all incoming emails for nk.local to a log file in the Temp folder
EdgeTransport.exe reads emails containing JPEG attachments with AES encrypted commands from the C2 server and uses steganography to extract the C2 communications from the attachments
The extracted data is base64 encoded
EdgeTransport.exe spawns cmd.exe to execute the embedded command from the C2 server
EdgeTransport.exe AES encrypts the command output to be returned to the C2
EdgeTransport.exe uses steganography to embed the C2 communications in a JPEG attachment
the JPEG is base64 encoded and added as an attachment to a MIME formatted email
EdgeTransport.exe communicates to the C2 server in an email to noreply@innovationmail.net using the .eml file
EdgeTransport.exe blocks the delivery of emails that contain C2 communications
Eventually, when tasked, EdgeTransport.exe exfiltrates the email log file over its existing C2 channel
msedge.exe sends the command output to the C2 server inside a HTTP request
connects over the HTTPS protocol
